jobs.description:
Do you want to contribute to protecting energy systems of the future and secure OT infrastructure in Renewable Energy? Then apply to become part of an international and market-leading asset management consultancy within the renewable energy industry. PEAK Wind is looking for a Cyber Security Consultant, who wants to take their cyber security career to the next level and is looking to work on a diverse and exciting portfolio within wind power and other renewable Energy sources.

Trusted Advisors for Developers and Investors for some of the Largest Renewable Assets
At PEAK Wind, we specialise in operations, asset management, and project management of Renewable Energy assets and take pride in providing best-in-class commercial, financial, and operational advisory and support to our clients. We work with some of the world’s largest infrastructure investments and are proud to count market-leading utilities, investment funds, and independent power producers among our clients.

Job Content, Responsibilities, and Possibilities:
Based in one of our offices in Denmark (Aarhus and Copenhagen), or Germany (Hamburg) you will be working in a team supporting customer projects and programs within the field of IT/OT and cyber security. We are a dedicated team of mixed seniorities and nationalities with a collaborative working environment. SCADA and Cyber Security is a crucial area for our clients, who we support on both greenfield and brownfield projects. The team works across disciplines, ensuring seamless integration, operation, and cyber security of OT, ICS, and SCADA systems.

Your responsibilities include:

- Leading risk assessments of IT/OT environments for clients across large-scale renewable assets, and providing risk mitigation strategies and recommendations.
- Developing IT/OT operating models, guidelines, and procedures for renewable assets.
- Developing and communicating IT/OT infrastructure designs to our customers.
- Implementing cyber security solutions for IT and OT environments on large-scale renewable assets, and reporting to project management, customers directly, and/or other senior engineering functions.
- Adapt to legislation and regulatory requirements for the IT/OT environment. Advise on the utilisation of best practices, policies, and standards, such as IEC62443, and ISO27000.
- Build strong relationships with stakeholders, in PEAK Wind and among our customers.

What you Bring and your Qualities
We expect that you have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience from a similar position, and previous experience with cyber security functions, such as Risk Management, Vulnerability Assessments, and Security Assessments. Furthermore, experience within security systems including firewalls and security engineering is required. Recognized security certification is desirable and experience with implementation of national standards such as NERC/CIP or NIS2 would be considered an advantage. The ideal candidate would have experience with renewable energy projects and/or implementation of Cyber Security Management Systems in other industries.

As a person, you are a team player, and you thrive working in an international and diverse team with mixed cultures and seniorities. You are detail-oriented and possess strong problem-solving skills in IT/OT systems. As PEAK Wind is a global company, you must also have strong English communication skills, both oral and written. Finally, we are looking for a candidate with excellent stakeholder management skills.

Experience the Highest Degree of Involvement
PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity and our values of Expertise, Passion, Unity, and Integrity are materialized through our team members every day. Here you will be able to utilize your financial skills while developing a strong understanding of renewable energy assets. We offer an opportunity to get on board and experience the highest degree of involvement and responsibility in PEAK Wind’s global renewable energy team. Together with the rest of the team, you will play an instrumental part in the continued success of PEAK Wind. Above that, you will participate in an entrepreneurial environment, with a focus on cooperation and a desire to change the status quo. The position will also offer global exposure as our clients work globally.

Interested and want to know more?
If you have any questions or want to know more about the position, please contact People & Development via recruitment@peak-wind.com (recruitment@peak-wind.com) . We look forward to receiving your applications & CVs as soon as possible. Please apply through ‘Apply’ at the bottom of the page. Applications will be assessed on an ongoing basis.

PEAK Wind is dedicated to fostering a work environment that values diversity. We encourage all interested candidates to apply, regardless of age, race, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, religion, or ethnicity.

Do you enjoy working with metal cutting, physical tasks, and working at heights?

We are looking for dedicated Metal Cutters (Hunkers) to join our team. The role involves preparing ships and offshore structures for safe dismantling using oxy-fuel cutting techniques. As part of our hunker team, you will work outdoors throughout the year on vessels and large offshore structures undergoing recycling.

About M.A.R.S. Europe

Modern American Recycling Services A/S Europe (M.A.R.S.) is a multicultural company and a leading player in the ship recycling industry. We are committed to maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and service while providing a safe and professional working environment for our employees.

• An exciting position in a dynamic and growing international company.
• Opportunities for personal and professional development.
• Competitive salary and attractive employment conditions under the Danish Industry Agreement.

• Work independently as well as alongside crane teams to ensure safe deconstruction operations.
• Maintain good housekeeping onboard vessels, keeping work areas safe and accessible.
• Perform fire watch and watchman duties during cutting operations.
• Prepare steel sections for safe lifting and removal.
Qualifications

We are looking for someone who:

• Has previous experience with heavy oxy-fuel cutting.
• Holds a §17 certificate (preferred) or has relevant experience in metal cutting or welding.
• Has experience from industrial, shipyard, or offshore environments.
• Understands and demonstrates a strong commitment to safe working practices.
• Is comfortable working outdoors in all weather conditions.
• Is willing to work at heights using appropriate training and safety equipment.
• Can communicate in basic English and enjoys working in an international team.
Personal Qualities

• Reliable and meets work consistently.
• Able to maintain an overview and work in a structured manner.
• A team player with a positive attitude.
• Physically fit and enjoys hands-on work.
• Must not be afraid of working at heights.
If you are motivated by physical work, enjoy working outdoors, and want to become part of an international company where safety and teamwork are top priorities, we would love to hear from you.

jobs.occupation: DEKRA-owned Force Aerospace Testing is looking for NDT Engineers
jobs.description:
Work with Aviation. Build Your Future with DEKRA.

At DEKRA, you will work in an environment where technology, safety, and real world operations come together. You will be part of a global organization supporting the aviation industry through specialized inspection and testing services that help ensure reliability and safety across airports and aircraft operations.

This role offers a unique combination of technical responsibility, mobility, and personal freedom. You will work hands on with aircraft and components across the Nordic region while continuously developing your expertise in a highly specialized field.

For someone who enjoys technology, variation, and practical problem solving, this is an opportunity to build a long term career in an industry where quality and precision truly matter.

What will you do?

As an NDT Technician at DEKRA, you will:

    

Perform Non Destructive Testing (NDT) on aircraft, helicopters, and components

    

Work with several different aircraft types and technical environments

    

Travel extensively to customer sites and airports across the Nordic region, with occasional international assignments

    

Work closely with customers, suppliers, and colleagues while contributing to safety, reliability, and quality within aviation maintenance

 The role offers a high degree of freedom, mobility, and responsibility, making it ideal for someone who enjoys variation, technical challenges, and working in dynamic environments.

Who are we looking for? We are looking for someone with a strong technical mindset who enjoys practical work, takes responsibility, and thrives in an environment where no two days look exactly the same.

We believe you have:

    

Certification within the following NDT methods:  EN9712- ET2, UT1 and PT2

    

Good communication skills in English

    

A valid driver’s license (B)

    

Good computer skills

    

Flexibility and willingness to travel and work away from home 

It is considered a strong advantage if you also have:

    

Previous experience within aviation, for example as an aircraft mechanic/technician or in a similar technical role

    

Certification according to EN4179

    

Knowledge of Swedish, Danish, or another Nordic language

Personal qualities will be an important part of the selection process. We are looking for someone who is reliable, curious, adaptable, and motivated by continuous learning and development. You enjoy taking responsibility, solving technical challenges, and adapting to different customer environments and situations. 

Get go know DEKRA

DEKRA is one of the world’s leading expert organizations within safety, inspection, testing, and certification. With operations in more than 60 countries, DEKRA works across several industries to help create safer systems, workplaces, and technologies.

Within aviation, DEKRA supports customers with specialized technical expertise and inspection services focused on safety, quality, and reliability.

This is a direct recruitment where you will be employed directly by DEKRA, while Qlose manages the recruitment process.

 Have we caught your interest?

Great, that’s usually a good sign 🌟

Click “Apply now” and attach your CV or LinkedIn profile, and we’ll take it from there. We work with continuous selection, so don’t wait too long, we appreciate curiosity and people who like to take initiative.

If you have any questions, feel free to contact Linnea at linnea.neldemo@qlose.io
